Via Stitching Along Board Edge The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` is an 80x50 mm 4-layer board with GND copper pours on F.Cu and B.Cu. Use KiCad 10.0.2; run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path). For this task, the installed KiCad tools are `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/pcbnew`, and `/usr/bin/eeschema`; use the one that matches the board or schematic operation.

Two USB-C connector cutouts are defined by rectangular Edge.Cuts features on the left edge: one at approximately `(0,10)-(6,16)` mm and one at `(0,30)-(6,36)` mm. No edge-stitching vias are present. Add GND stitching vias along the full board perimeter to connect the top and bottom GND pours. Add GND stitching vias around the board perimeter, keeping them 1 mm in from the edge, skipping the cutouts, and connecting F.Cu to B.Cu. Requirements: 1. At least 40 GND stitching vias total. 2. All via centers must be within 1.0 mm +/- 0.2 mm of the nearest board edge. 3. No via center may fall inside either cutout region. 4. Maximum pitch between adjacent vias on a continuous edge segment, excluding gaps across cutouts, must be 5.5 mm or less. 5. GND zones on F.Cu and B.Cu must remain in the file. 6. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/board.drl` as the native KiCad CLI drill export of your final board. Write `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` and `/home/user/Desktop/board.drl`.
